movie.title: Alter Ego
movie.overview: Alex, a quiet forty-something, leads an ordinary life until new neighbours move in. The husband is Alex’s perfect lookalike… except for one thing: he has hair. Alex sinks into a growing paranoia as he becomes preoccupied with this more charismatic, brilliant and accomplished mysterious double.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: An ordinary man becomes consumed by jealousy and paranoia after a charismatic, identical double moves in next door.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Alex leads a quiet and unremarkable life in his nineties until new neighbors arrive, revealing a husband who looks exactly like him but boasts a full head of hair and a thriving personality. As the charming stranger quickly wins over the community, Alex finds himself trapped in an obsession with his superior counterpart. Driven by deep-seated insecurity, Alex's escalating paranoia threatens to unravel his peaceful existence and shatter his sense of identity.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Alex, a reserved man in his nineties, lives a thoroughly predictable and mundane routine. His quiet world is disrupted when a vibrant couple moves into the house next door, bringing an unsettling surprise. To Alex's shock, the new husband is his perfect physical double, with the single striking exception of possessing a full head of hair. While Alex is timid and unassuming, his lookalike proves to be magnetic, brilliant, and remarkably accomplished. As the neighbor effortlessly charms everyone in their shared social circle, Alex begins to feel increasingly eclipsed and insecure. He starts obsessively monitoring his double's life, searching for flaws or secrets behind the man's pristine facade. The persistent comparison slowly erodes Alex's self-esteem, driving him into an intense spiral of psychological fixation. His fixation turns into an overwhelming obsession as he questions his own self-worth and place in the world. Ultimately, Alex must confront his inner demons and growing paranoia before his desperate envy completely destroys his identity and peace of mind.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Alex lives an ordinary, quiet life until a new couple moves in next door and alters his reality forever. The incoming neighbor is Alex's exact physical duplicate, save for one distinct trait: he has a full head of hair. Beyond his appearance, this enigmatic double possesses a charming demeanor, brilliant intellect, and an impressive resume that contrasts sharply with Alex's own low-key existence. As the newcomer effortlessly captivates the neighborhood, Alex sinks into a psychological obsession, driven by insecurity and an escalating paranoia regarding the mysterious man who seems to be a superior version of himself.

story_structure.climax: Alex's escalating obsession reaches a breaking point, forcing a tense, direct confrontation between his fragile sense of identity and the enigmatic life of his double.
story_structure.conflict: Alex is shocked to discover that the new neighbour is his exact lookalike, possessing the charisma, brilliance, and hair that Alex lacks, triggering an immediate internal crisis.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the confrontation, Alex is forced to grapple with the disturbing reality of his self-worth and the true nature of his identity.
story_structure.introduction: Alex, an ordinary forty-something man, lives a quiet and unassuming life until a new couple moves in next door.
story_structure.risingAction: As Alex becomes increasingly fixated on his vibrant double, his fascination turns into deep paranoia, leading him to obsessively monitor and compare his mundane life to his neighbour's seemingly superior existence.
